description: A textured CityGML 2.0 document read and written back under new-geometry: the selected theme is emitted, the app:target resolves to a gml:id in the same document, and every texture coordinate is flipped back to CityGML's bottom-left origin. New-world only: the legacy Feature CityGML 2 Reader builds no appearance at all (pipeline.rs::build_citygml_geometry leaves materials and textures empty), so the legacy build writes the same geometry with no app:appearanceMember and the two cannot share one expectation.
